en: A vintage postcard image depicting a street scene with tram tracks and an old tram car in a European-style city. The street is lined with multi-story buildings with balconies and shuttered windows. Several people are visible, including a person in traditional clothing. The text 'ALEXANDRIE, RUE PORTE ROSETTE' is printed at the top, and there is a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' at the bottom.
